      "observations": [
        "The assigned historical API accepts an omitted tags.create key and delegates generation to MailServices.tags.addTag, then returns getKeyForTag. Supplied keys are lowercased and checked for collisions; duplicate display names are rejected. The deprecated createTag wrapper awaits the shared operation without returning its key, so its undefined resolved result remains distinct from the newer API.",
        "Fixed generation is native service output, not a stable slug duplicated in the extension layer. The checked native service reuses an existing display-name mapping, escapes UTF-8 bytes, lowercases keys, adds numeric collision suffixes and can use a hash when the readable key exceeds its limit. Historical tests expected auto_tag/auto_taga; current feature tests expect auto=20tag and auto=20tag_1. No later generator change receives chronology credit.",
        "Current updates treat nonempty color/name and ordinal differently: ordinal != null allows an empty string to clear it while omission leaves it unchanged. This existing field-specific contract must not be flattened into a single truthiness/default rule. Newer feature tests and schema are static comparison source, not executed API behavior.",
        "The complete own Bug asks for native UI-equivalent key generation and returned keys. Removing arbitrary custom keys is only proposed, and reproducing an arbitrary existing profile mapping still needs the original key/name relation. In actual rows1305839/1306983 the author keeps the deprecated createTag schema/result unchanged and directs new return-value use to messages.tags.create. Rows1305840/1306989 distinguish native collision handling from duplicating it in JavaScript: renaming a tag retains its key, so recreating the old name can require a distinct key. This is a local compatibility/native-ownership decision, not a universal ban on changing deprecated APIs."
      ],
